name: Radio cards
summary: A choice between a few options, such as a provider or a way to sign in, drawn as cards. Nothing is chosen until someone chooses.

when: For a choice between two to five options that each need a sentence of explanation.

anatomy.description: A radio button, its label and a description.

props.name: label
props.description: The question, as the group's legend.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help under the label, such as an example. Pass a catalogue string.

props.name: error
props.description: The error message. Setting it marks the field invalid; clearing it marks it valid. The app validates.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the form submits the value under.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether it must be filled in. Screen readers say so; the app checks it.

props.name: options
props.items: value, label, and an optional description

states.name: Nothing chosen
states.description: Every card is unselected, so the choice is deliberate.

states.name: Chosen
states.description: The chosen card has the selected surface and a strong border.

states.name: Focus
states.description: A 2px focus ring around the card.

accessibility.name: Its legend.

keyboard.action: Moves into the group, to the chosen card or the first.
Choose the next or previous option.

screenReader: Announced as a group with its legend, then each option as a radio button with its label and description.
notes: Native radios, so keyboard and form behaviour are the browser's own.
Each card is at least 44px high.

related.relationship: Will show each provider's logo on its card.

guidelines: The legend is a question, such as “Where should your account live?”.
Descriptions say what each choice means for the person.

dosAndDonts.do: Leave every option unchosen at first.

evidence.point: No default, so people make a real choice of provider (decision in #9).
Radio group semantics, with native radios.
